regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative structure: Banks (H + HK) is the only high-durability, gate-eligible leader (durability 0.61, eligible, not crowded), with High-Dividend Blue Chips the sole challenger (eligible=false) and only 2 of 17 themes passing the absolute-trend gate. Rotation is display-only and non-directional; cross-sectional rank has no alpha, so this is a leadership/focus snapshot, not a return forecast. The macro backdrop is AI-tech/geopolitics-heavy with 100% unscheduled surprises, which makes single-theme conviction especially fragile.
emerging_watch: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the rotation challenger (score 1.008, second-highest durability of the non-eligible names at 0.31) but is NOT yet gate-eligible. Watching for it to cross the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) while maintaining breadth above its current 0.25 — if it does not pass the gate within the next 15 trading days, the watch is retired.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the lone gate-eligible leader with the highest durability (0.61), positive breadth (0.462), and no crowding flag, so it is the only theme where the absolute-trend gate currently permits exposure. The overweight is a conditional preference within the eligible set, not a momentum prediction: among the two eligible names, Banks shows stronger trend health than Conglomerates & Exchange (durability 0.49 vs 0.46 breadth). The detector's one validated edge is drawdown control via the gate, and Banks is the cleanest expression of that staying-power leg.
evidence: trend gate: only eligible theme alongside Conglomerates & Exchange; gate_helps=true on this market
one_narrative=true with Banks as headline theme, absorption 0.48
theses.dissent: Gate_helps being true only validates lower drawdown, not higher return; the rank itself has ~0 forward IC, so Banks leading today says nothing about the next 20 days. H-shares banks are policy-sensitive and the macro backdrop (100% unscheduled, geopolitics-heavy) could reprice the group on any single announcement. The one_narrative structure is exactly the regime where reflexivity can punish a crowded consensus — even at crowding_z 0.55, inflows/attention spikes historically mark tops, not entries.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) is no longer gate-eligible (drops below the absolute-trend threshold) or its durability_bar falls below 0.50 before the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: Conglomerates & Exchange is gate-eligible (the only other eligible theme) but shows zero breadth (0.0) and middling durability (0.49), with a daily return near zero (r10 around -0.0055 on the headline suggests thin trend). The avoid is not a short or a fade — it is a refusal to lean into a theme that passes the gate on a technicality but lacks internal confirmation. With only two eligible names, choosing the non-breadth one adds concentration without a compensating trend-health signal.
evidence: eligible=true but breadth=0.0 (all other eligible themes show higher breadth)

In a mean-reverting tape, the unloved eligible name with zero breadth could be the one that catches a policy or exchange-flow bid precisely because nobody holds it. Avoid may forgo the only diversification available to the eligible set.
